d:
Scorching rock walls, zero shade, and a ticking clock where one wrong turn means dehydration. Step into the unforgiving wilderness of the Moab Desert in Utah in Man vs. Wild as Bear Grylls faces impossible situations and pulls off incredible escapes. Demonstrating raw desert survival skills and life-saving survival techniques, he navigates narrow canyons, tracks hidden water sources, and pushes human endurance against punishing heat.
Watch Man vs. Wild Season 1 Episodes 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 & 14 on Discovery Channel India.
